name: 小颗粒日晒不粘连枸杞款
description: 小颗粒日晒红枸杞，果粒松散不粘连，原野晨光木勺自然系套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: airy sunny meadow-sky gradient panels #8FAE6B to #A9C7E4 for hero, clean cloud-white #F7F9F3 for info shots, warm off-white #F5F1E8 for trust; warm natural wood tones #9C6B3F / #C89A6B appear only as surfaces and props
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright natural daylight, soft top-front key around 5500K with a gentle warm cast, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light wooden planks #C89A6B, grey striped linen #B9BDC2, coarse burlap #C9A876, matte light-stone counter #D9D6D0
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #3A3A3A with one goji-red #C2352B accent, no brush calligraphy, no decorative script; warm natural wood tones carried by props and surfaces, never by the palette chips
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line numbered circles and simple leaf motifs, single red accent #C2352B
styleLock.presentationRules: loose dry product piles and wooden scoops shown at stable slight 3/4 or overhead angles, consistent scale across the set, product never floating
noDrift: no brush calligraphy or decorative script
styleLock.lockText: consistent bright natural meadow-style dried-fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of airy cloud white #F7F9F3, fresh meadow green #8FAE6B, charcoal text #3A3A3A and one deep goji-red accent #C2352B, with warm natural wood tones #9C6B3F and #C89A6B appearing only as surface and prop colors; warm tone, bright natural daylight with a soft top-front key around 5500K and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal, no brush calligraphy; consistent thin-line numbered circles and simple leaf motifs in the red accent; light wooden planks, grey striped linen and coarse burlap as the surface language; loose dry product piles and wooden scoops presented at stable angles and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush calligraphy, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用明快原野大场景建立自然第一印象，抢占点击
shots.camera: slightly low angle below eye-level with a gentle upward tilt, product group placed in the lower third
shots.lighting: bright natural morning daylight, soft top-front key, warm cast around 5800K, soft contact shadow
shots.background: sunny meadow gradient grass green #8FAE6B into pale sky blue #A9C7E4, light wooden plank ledge #C89A6B
shots.props: a dark matte ceramic bowl holding the product, a few loose pieces scattered naturally on the planks
shots.textZone: upper 40% of frame set on the clean sky area: one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one short subline 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero key visual of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product piled loosely in a dark matte ceramic bowl resting on a light wooden plank ledge, photographed from a slightly low angle below eye-level with a gentle upward tilt, the bowl large and generous in the lower two thirds of the frame. Bright natural morning daylight, soft top-front key, warm cast around 5800K, a soft contact shadow grounding the bowl. Airy sunny meadow backdrop, grass green #8FAE6B blending upward into pale sky blue #A9C7E4, light wooden planks #C89A6B. A few loose pieces scattered naturally beside the bowl. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, filling the lower two thirds with the upper 40% of the sky carrying one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one short subline 「{callout_1}」 rendered in #3A3A3A with a #C2352B accent word, the composition balanced between bowl and text. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no dense body text, no brush calligraphy, no floating product without contact shadow, no duplicated background textures, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源图仅 6 屏：原野晨光首屏、木勺麻布卖点、优势编号清单+红色等价带、专业/工艺/产地三联细节、颗粒展示与勺中特写。已剥离原品牌字、书法标题、店铺会员二维码浮层及全部功效/产地/含量文案（花青素当量、产地表述等只保留信息结构，改由图内具名文案槽由使用方填入真实信息）。补足 3 镜凑齐漏斗：受潮结块对比痛点（源自『不易粘连结块』卖点结构）、颗粒尺寸规格图（源自颗粒尺寸文案结构，数值改为具名文案槽）、组合装 CTA 收口；补足镜未新增源图没有的规格或卖点。归类依据：图中为干枸杞果粒（泡茶/煮粥食材定位），落 食品饮料/冲调，而非医药保健/营养补充；全部保健功效语义已剥离。与库内既有枸杞套图（墨蓝暗调+米白瓷碗+金色卷章+瓷碗泡饮）采用完全不同的明快原野自然光视觉系统。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
